name: com.utilityhouse/agentready-woo
description: Agentic commerce readiness for self-hosted WooCommerce stores. Free scan grades a store's agent-readiness out of 100, then exposes its live catalog through a per-store MCP tool surface: search_products, get_offer, get_feed, create_cart_link, verify_cart_link. Checkout completes on the merchant's own store via a signed cart handoff — no card data passes through this service.
